data.name: Gerhardine
data.gender_notes: Gerhardine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements ger 'spear' and hard 'ruler'. This name was borne by a 13th-century German saint and by several figures in medieval literature. The name Gerhardine carries the meaning “Spear strength, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerhardine usually hope their child will grow to embody spear strength, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace strength and leadership in your spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Gerhardine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spear strength, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerhardine total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: גרהרדין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גרהרדין הוא נגזרת של השם הגרמני 'גרהרד', שמשמעותו 'חזקה של רומח הקרב'. השם מורכב מ'גר' שפירושו 'רומח' ו'הרד' שפירושו 'חזק'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והינו בעל משמעות רוחנית עמוקה.

in_greek.name: Γκερχαρδίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκερχαρδίνη είναι μια γερμανική προέλευση που σημαίνει 'ένδεια Γκέρχαρτ', όπου το 'Γκέρχαρτ' αποτελείται από το 'γκερ' που σημαίνει 'αξίνα' και το 'χαρτ' που σημαίνει 'γενναίος'. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε από τους πρώτους Χριστιανούς και έχει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Gerhardine
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gerhardine ex origine Germanica derivatur, quod 'fortis hastae Gerhard' significat. Compositum est ex 'ger' quod 'hasta' et 'hard' quod 'fortis' significat. Nomen hoc in usu Christianorum fuit et profundam significationem spiritualem habet.

in_english.name: Gerhardine
in_english.meaning: Strong spear or brave with the spear
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gerhardine originates from Germanic roots, specifically from 'ger' meaning 'spear' and 'hard' meaning 'strong' or 'brave'. This name conveys a sense of strength and courage in battle. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, the components of the name reflect a warrior-like spirit often praised in Christian tradition. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing bravery and spiritual strength.
